mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM vi_m1_sv_meas_now WHERE to_char(meas_dt, 'YYYYMM') = #{yyyymm};

/* istec.datDownload - 2022.03 .dat 파일 다운로드 기능 (author : gyubeom_park) */ WITH w1 AS ( SELECT to_char(meas_dt, 'YYYYMM') AS ms_dt, * FROM vi_m1_sv_meas_now WHERE to_char(meas_dt, 'YYYYMM') = #{yyyymm}) , w2 AS ( SELECT t1.ms_dt AS ms_dt , '1' AS sg_cd , get_char_as_length(REPLACE(t2.admin_id, '-', ''), 15) AS house_id , '1' AS res_kind , '01' AS sub_cd , lpad(t2.check_day::varchar, 2, '0') AS check_day , get_char_as_byte_length(t2.cust_nm, 30) AS cust_nm , get_char_as_byte_length(t2.addr_new, 56) AS addr , CASE LEFT(t2.stat_cd, 1) WHEN '1' THEN '07' WHEN '5' THEN '05' ELSE '00' END AS stat_cd , get_char_as_length(trunc(t1.accu_iv)::text, 13) AS month_val , get_char_as_length(t1.term_cv_30d::text, 13) AS month_use , get_char_as_length(t2.note, 60) AS note , get_char_as_length(t2.cust_phone, 30) AS phone_num , '0' AS phone_modi , get_char_as_length(t2.meter_pos, 100) AS m_pos , '0' AS m_pos_modi FROM w1 t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN vi_m1_sv_point_list t2 ON t2.point_sq = t1.point_sq WHERE t2.use_cd = '1') SELECT * FROM w2;
